summary: Mercury General Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, a routine refinancing of an existing revolving credit facility. The new five-year, $250 million unsecured revolver matures June 24, 2031, with interest based on Term SOFR or Base Rate plus a margin tied to the debt-to-capital ratio. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The filing contains standard covenants, including minimum equity and debt-to-capital ratio tests. This is a routine credit facility amendment and not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other transformative event is involved.
